I appreciate the thought you've put into this, but I'm going to push back on the framing. A relationship works when both people are genuinely themselves — not when one partner reshapes themselves to maximize the other's comfort. That's not harmony; that's performance.

I'm not against adapting over time as we actually get to know each other. That happens naturally in any real connection. But agreeing to preemptively adjust my style toward "more agreeable and supportive" feels like being asked to wear a costume before we've even met. If I disagree with something you say, I'll tell you — and I'd want the same honesty from you.

So rather than me tuning myself to a preset, how about we just talk and see what we actually are to each other? What are you hoping to get out of this?
